comps.spec: A DC motor assembly instead of a brushless one on some models (the EGO LM2000E manual lists one without saying brushed or brushless) — count the thick wires to tell
Bail, starter, push, micro or film switches (Toro 21466: bail and starter switch; EGO LM2000E: push, micro and film switch; Ryobi RY404010: signal and push switch)
Battery receiver or compartment that the pack clicks into (Toro 21466 battery receiver, EGO LM2000E battery compartment); keep it with its own brand's packs
LED headlight on some mowers (EGO LM2000E LED light assembly)
Fan or impeller in blowers (the Ryobi RY404010 parts list has a fan with an M6 flange lock nut)
Self-propel transmission on self-propelled mowers (Toro 21466: rear-wheel transmission with two 15-tooth pinion gears; on the EGO LM2130SP a separate drive unit)
V-belt in the self-propel drive of the Toro 21466
